Leverage is high with a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 2.74 and a debt-to-assets ratio of 73.3%, suggesting elevated financial risk. Although the operating margin is a relatively strong 19.1%, the return on assets is low at approximately 0.95%, reflecting inefficient asset utilization. These factors, combined with negative working capital, point to a high credit risk consistent with a speculative grade rating. The positive EBIT and retained earnings provide some cushion but are insufficient to offset the liquidity and leverage concerns.

DECISION: B-
